◆ initArgs

DynamicString superdex::robotics::ControllerEntry::initArgs = DynamicString("{}")

The controller's init args as a serialized JSON object – the contents of the scene entry's nested "initArgs" object (e.g.

{"baseLinkName":..,"eeLinkName":..} for link-resolved controllers, or a model path for a learned controller). Passed verbatim to ControllerBase::ConfigureFromSceneEntry, which deserializes it into a controller-specific struct, so the scene loader never needs to know a controller's fields. Reflected with the JsonString attribute: on load the nested "initArgs" object is captured into this string, and on save it is re-emitted as a nested object (round-trip identity), so no bespoke parsing is needed. May also be set or modified directly (e.g. from Python) before LoadBotScene. Defaults to an empty object ("{}"), which NoSerializeDefaults omits from the saved file. (Legacy scenes that interleave flat controller fields instead of a nested "initArgs" object are folded into this string at load time – see LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile; new scenes and all saves use the nested form.)
